description.value: Barn Owl Brewing is a community-focused craft brewery housed in a beautifully restored 1920s Surtees family dairy barn on Kelowna's Lakeshore Road, listed on the BC Ale Trail. The brewery is BC Green Business Certified, uses a water-efficient BREWHA system, and feeds spent grain to a local cattle farm. Touring cyclists will find 20+ small-batch beers alongside rotating food trucks (wood-fired pizza and handmade ramen), plus a lively weekly events calendar featuring live music and a run club.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the fetched website content from barnowlbrewing.ca, which confirms the business name, address, phone, and operational status. The website describes food offerings (food trucks, in-house snacks, no kitchen) and sustainability credentials but makes no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those fields are null per the absence-of-evidence rule. OSM tags are consistent with the website for name, phone, and address; a minor discrepancy in opening hours between OSM and the website is flagged in concerns.
